name: International Business
summary: The broad business economics degree — strategy, finance, marketing, organisation — with everything framed around companies operating across borders. About half the compulsory courses use mathematics as a working tool, at roughly the level of the entry requirement. Its 2026 quota 1 cut-off, 11.1, was the highest of CBS's six English-taught bachelors on this site, and a third of the students are non-Danish.
